items.title: Google releases TorchTPU, open-source PyTorch support for its TPUs
items.summary: Google announced TorchTPU, a PyTorch implementation for its TPU chips, joining Amazon's similar effort to loosen Nvidia's grip on AI app developers.
items.whyItMatters: Easier PyTorch-on-TPU could eventually lower inference costs for self-hosted STT/TTS models of the kind a voice tutor might run.

items.title: US orders federal agencies to remove DeepSeek AI from their systems
items.summary: DHS directed federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and related third-party services, citing concerns over Chinese government access to user data.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing if you ever consider DeepSeek as a cheap LLM backend: data-residency and compliance concerns are growing.
